S: Button mushrooms filled with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesan
Button mushrooms stuffed with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
Red and green grapes, brie, fresh figs and honey
Bunches of red and green grapes piled on a big platter with a wedge of brie, halved fresh figs and a little pot of honey for drizzling over the cheese.
the dancing hippos in the Dance of the Hours

Light, golden choux puffs beaten with gruyère and a little mustard, crisp outside and hollow inside, served warm. Boil 250ml water with 100g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute until it leaves the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays, top with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: Eggplant layered with cinnamon spiced lamb and tomato

Layers of golden eggplant and cinnamon-spiced lamb sauce under a thick, creamy béchamel, baked until bubbling and browned on top. Slice 2 eggplants 1cm thick, brush with oil and grill or fry until golden. Brown 600g lamb mince with 1 diced onion, 1 tsp cinnamon and 400g diced tomatoes, and simmer 20 minutes. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g plain flour, then whisk in 600ml milk until thick, and beat in 1 egg off the heat. Layer eggplant and lamb in a dish, pour over the béchamel and bake at 180C for 40 minutes.
Rite of Spring garlic rosemary lamb
the dinosaurs in the Rite of Spring

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink, sliced with crispy roast potatoes, pumpkin and a rich pan gravy. Make small cuts all over a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers of 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with olive oil and salt. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes for medium, with 1kg potato chunks and 600g pumpkin pieces tossed in oil around it. Rest the lamb 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, add 300ml beef stock and simmer until thick.
W: Small baked meringues, crisp outside and light inside
Meringue kisses baked at 100C for an hour, dusted with edible glitter and served with berries.
K: Purple grape juice with rosemary syrup and frozen grapes

Dark grape juice shaken with lemon and rosemary syrup, topped with sparkling water in goblets, with frozen grapes for ice. Freeze 200g red grapes on a tray for 2 hours. Simmer 3 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool. In a jug, mix 600ml purple grape juice, the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lemon. Pour into 4 goblets over the frozen grapes and top each with sparkling water. Garnish with a small rosemary sprig.

s.note: Button mushrooms filled with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesan
s.how: Remove the stalks from 500g button mushrooms. Mix softened butter with crushed garlic, breadcrumbs, grated parmesan and chopped parsley. Press a spoonful into each mushroom cap and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve warm on a platter.

s.note: Red and green grapes, brie, fresh figs and honey
s.how: Wash bunches of red and green grapes and pile them on a big platter. Add a whole wedge of brie at room temperature and halve 6 fresh figs around it. Set a little pot of honey in the middle so everyone can drizzle it over the cheese and figs.

m.note: Eggplant layered with cinnamon spiced lamb and tomato
m.how: Slice 2 eggplants 1cm thick, brush with oil and grill or fry until golden. Brown 600g lamb mince with 1 diced onion, 1 tsp cinnamon and 400g diced tomatoes, and simmer 20 minutes. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g plain flour, then whisk in 600ml milk until thick, and beat in 1 egg off the heat. Layer eggplant and lamb in a dish, pour over the béchamel and bake at 180C for 40 minutes.

w.note: Small baked meringues, crisp outside and light inside
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Pipe small kisses onto lined trays and bake at 100C for an hour. Cool in the oven, dust with edible glitter and serve with fresh raspberries.

d.note: Purple grape juice with rosemary syrup and frozen grapes
d.how: Freeze 200g red grapes on a tray for 2 hours. Simmer 3 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool. In a jug, mix 600ml purple grape juice, the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lemon. Pour into 4 goblets over the frozen grapes and top each with sparkling water. Garnish with a small rosemary sprig.
